title: Penis
summary: The penis is the external male sexual organ. It has a shaft and a sensitive head (glans) and contains the urethra, which carries urine and semen.
key_points: Erections happen when spongy tissue fills with blood.
Size varies a lot; size has little to do with a partner's pleasure or with fertility.
Slight curves are common and usually normal; a painful or sudden bend is worth a doctor's check.
answer_guidance: Users often ask about size anxiety; reassure with facts, without mocking or comparing.
